_help: Windows version — see svg-preview.linux-macos.json for Linux (some distros package the same resvg tool under the binary name rendersvg instead). Preview generator config — see docs/generators.md for the full guide. JSON has no comment syntax, so this is just a regular field; Waydir ignores every key starting with "_" when loading, so these are safe to delete once you know the format.
_help_extensions: Lowercase file extensions (no dot) this generator handles.
_help_cmd: The executable to run — must be on PATH, or an absolute path.
_help_args: resvg <in-svg> <out-png>, with --width fixing the output width while preserving the SVG's own aspect ratio (verified: a 200x100 SVG renders at 640x320). Background stays transparent (resvg's default) since outputExt is png. Placeholders substituted in every element: %INPUT% the source file's real path, %OUTPUT% where to write the result image (must end up with the "outputExt" extension below), %CACHE% a scratch directory (unused here), %SEEK%/%POSITION%/%PAGE% only meaningful for paged generators (unused here, this one has no "paging" key).
_help_timeoutSeconds: Max seconds before the command is killed and treated as failed. 1-60.
_help_outputExt: File extension of the generated image — must match what "args" actually writes to %OUTPUT%.
